items.title: US navy chief says $14bn arms sale to Taiwan paused due to Iran war
items.description: Hung Cao told a Senate hearing they were "doing a pause" on the sale to make sure they had munitions for the Iran war.

items.title: Rubio says Cuba is threat to US as Havana accuses him of 'lies'
items.description: Cuba's foreign minister accused Rubio of trying to "instigate a military aggression".

items.title: Three ways Cuba crisis could play out  after US indictment of Raúl Castro
items.description: The Trump administration has been putting tremendous economic pressure on the island's Communist government.

items.title: US sanctions Tanzanian police official over 'torture' of rights activists
items.description: The sanctions come amid growing scrutiny of Tanzania’s human rights record in recent years.

items.title: Africa summit in India postponed over Ebola outbreak fears
items.description: The India-Africa summit was set to be held next week in Delhi after more than a decade.

items.title: Alberta to hold referendum on whether to remain in Canada
items.description: Voters in the western province will decide next October whether they want to stay in Canada or move ahead with a process for a binding independence referendum.

items.title: 'No means no': Greenlanders protest against Trump outside new US consulate
items.description: The inauguration of the new consulate comes amid a push by the US president for greater control over the island.

items.title: US to send 5,000 more troops to Poland, Trump says
items.description: The announcement comes a week after the Pentagon cancelled a planned deployment of 4,000 troops to the country.

items.title: Angry crowd sets Ebola hospital tents on fire in DR Congo
items.description: Grieving relatives and friends of a suspected Ebola victim were prevented from taking his body for burial.

items.title: Musk's SpaceX postpones Starship launch as mega share sale looms
items.description: It comes just a day after the firm revealed plans for a record-breaking stock market debut.

items.title: Australian man dies after falling down ravine on hike to Machu Picchu
items.description: The body of Matthew Cameron Paton, 53, was found on Thursday, about 300m down a steep slope.

items.title: Tennessee execution called off after failed lethal injection
items.description: Tony Carruthers was granted a one-year reprieve from death after his executioners failed to find a vein for lethal injection.
